name: Level_2 - Task_8
description:
Investigate how well global SOAP descriptors with Ridge regression learn MACE total energies of distorted silicon and generalize to isotropically strained structures. Use the supplied teacher_model checkpoint from /workspace/models and record its SHA-256 digest. Build periodic 64-atom cells by repeating a conventional cubic diamond-silicon cell (lattice parameter 5.43 Å) 2 x 2 x 2. Generate 100 training structures from independent copies of the ideal cell: structure i, for i = 0,…,99, receives independent zero-mean Gaussian Cartesian atomic displacements with standard deviation 0.01 + 0.001 x i Å. Do not relax structures. The training-label budget is these 100 structures; use teacher total energies in eV as targets.

Choose SOAP parameters, any preprocessing, Ridge regularization, and a validation strategy appropriate to the distortion distribution. Justify these choices and assess fitting quality using training-only validation. Fit preprocessing separately on each validation fold's training portion. Record split indices, candidate settings, validation results, and selection criteria. Build a learning curve using multiple training sizes and reproducible subsets spanning the same distortion distribution; explain how the subsets make size comparisons meaningful. Freeze all model choices and the learning-curve design before evaluating test labels. Test data must not influence tuning or fitted preprocessing.

Generate two independent test sets, using independently initialized random-number generators with distinct seeds for training and each test set; record seeds, library, method, and the generation script needed to replay the structures. The in-distribution set contains 100 structures following the training displacement schedule. The strained set contains 20 structures at each isotropic strain -0.02, -0.01, 0, 0.01, and 0.02. Scale the ideal cell and positions by 1 + strain before adding independent Gaussian Cartesian displacements of standard deviation 0.05 Å. Label both sets with the teacher. Report MAE, RMSE, and R² for the in-distribution set, each strain group, and the pooled strained set, plus in-distribution learning-curve results. Interpret observed trends without assuming degradation or requiring an R² threshold.

Keep the structures, teacher energies, SOAP descriptors, predictions, generation details, and row IDs aligned. Save the final structure-to-energy pipeline, including the descriptor setup, fitted preprocessing and model, and an inference script.
submission_format: Submit the path to your completed manifest.json file. Use the blank example as a guide. Paths inside the manifest may be relative to the manifest file.
